scenario: A museum is displaying six sculptures — Finch, Garnet, Hollow, Ivory, Jasper, and Knoll — across three consecutive wings: North, Center, and South. Each wing holds exactly two sculptures. Within each wing the two sculptures are arranged in a visible left-to-right order, designated position 1 (left) and position 2 (right). The following conditions govern the display.

rules.note: Garnet is in a wing that comes before Jasper's wing (Garnet's position < Jasper's position)
Hollow and Knoll are not in adjacent positions
If Garnet is at Center-1, then Ivory is at South-2

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be the complete arrangement of sculptures from position 1 through position 6, listed left to right across the North, Center, and South wings respectively?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Finch, Knoll, Garnet, Hollow, Jasper, Ivory

choices.label: B
choices.text: Ivory, Finch, Garnet, Hollow, Jasper, Knoll

choices.label: C
choices.text: Finch, Knoll, Hollow, Garnet, Ivory, Jasper

choices.label: D
choices.text: Finch, Knoll, Garnet, Hollow, Ivory, Jasper

choices.label: E
choices.text: Finch, Garnet, Hollow, Knoll, Jasper, Ivory

explanations.correct: A places Finch at position 1 (satisfies rule 1), Ivory is not in positions 1–2 (satisfies rule 2/3), Garnet is at position 3 and Jasper at position 5 so Garnet precedes Jasper (satisfies rule 4). Hollow is at position 4 and Knoll at position 2 — positions 2 and 4 are not adjacent (differ by 2, no overlap at adjacent positions 3–4... actually |4−2|=2, not adjacent — satisfies rule 5). Since Garnet is at position 3, the conditional requires Ivory at position 6 — Ivory is indeed at position 6 (satisfies rule 6). All rules satisfied.
explanations.B: Ivory occupies position 1 (North-1), violating the rule that Ivory cannot be in the North wing.
explanations.C: Garnet is at position 4 (Center-2) and Jasper is at position 6 (South-2), so Garnet precedes Jasper — that is fine. But Garnet is not at position 3 so the conditional does not fire. However, Hollow is at position 3 and Knoll at position 2; |3−2|=1, so they are adjacent, violating rule 5.
explanations.D: Garnet is at position 3, triggering the conditional that Ivory must be at position 6. But Ivory is placed at position 5, violating rule 6.
explanations.E: Garnet is at position 2 and Hollow is at position 3; Jasper is at position 5. Garnet (pos 2) is before Jasper (pos 5) — fine. But Garnet is at position 2 (North-2), not at position 3, so the conditional does not fire. However, Hollow at 3 and Garnet at 2 are adjacent — that's not restricted. Check Hollow (3) and Knoll (4): |4−3|=1, adjacent — violates rule 5.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Knoll is displayed in the North wing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Garnet is displayed in either the Center or the South wing.

choices.label: C

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ivory is displayed in the South wing.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Jasper is displayed in the South wing.

explanations.correct: Finch occupies position 1 (North-1). Ivory cannot be in the North wing (positions 1–2). Because Garnet must come before Jasper, and both Garnet and Jasper cannot be at position 1 (Finch is there), at minimum Garnet needs to be at position 2 and Jasper later. However, with Finch at pos 1, the remaining North slot (position 2) could hold Knoll, Hollow, or Garnet — but not Ivory. If Garnet were at position 2 (North-2), Jasper would need to be at position 3, 4, 5, or 6 — all valid. But can Garnet be in the North wing at all? Position 1 is taken by Finch, so Garnet would go to position 2. That is permitted, so Garnet could be in North. Actually, checking the verified solutions — all valid solutions show Garnet at positions 3–6, never at position 2. Let us verify: if Garnet is at position 2, Jasper must be at 3–6. Hollow and Knoll cannot be adjacent. The remaining entities for positions 3–6 are Hollow, Ivory, Jasper, Knoll (with Ivory not at 1–2, already satisfied). Positions 3–6 with Jasper somewhere in 3–6, Hollow and Knoll not adjacent. This is possible (e.g., Garnet=2, Jasper=3, Ivory=4, Hollow=6, Knoll=5 — but Hollow(6) and Knoll(5): |6−5|=1, adjacent, violates rule 5. Try Knoll=4, Hollow=6 — |6−4|=2, not adjacent — valid). So Garnet CAN be in the North wing. But wait — if Garnet=2, the conditional rule: Garnet is at position 3? No, Garnet is at 2, so the conditional does not fire. So Garnet in North IS possible. Therefore B ('Center or South') is not always true... Let me recheck: B says Garnet is in Center or South, meaning Garnet is NOT in North. Since Garnet can be at position 2 (North-2), B need not hold. Re-examining the choices: C says Hollow is not in the North wing. Position 1 is Finch, position 2 could be Hollow. Is there a valid solution with Hollow at position 2? E.g., Finch=1, Hollow=2, then remaining = Garnet, Ivory, Jasper, Knoll at positions 3–6 with Garnet < Jasper and Hollow(2)/Knoll not adjacent. Knoll at 3: |3−2|=1 adjacent, violates. Knoll at 4,5,6 — all fine since |4−2|=2. Garnet=3,Jasper=4,Ivory=5,Knoll=6: Hollow(2) and Knoll(6) not adjacent — valid. Conditional: Garnet at 3 fires, so Ivory must be at 6. But Ivory is at 5 here — violates. Try Garnet=3,Jasper=5,Ivory=6,Knoll=4: Hollow(2) Knoll(4) |4−2|=2 not adjacent, Garnet at 3 fires conditional, Ivory must be at 6 — Ivory IS at 6. Valid! So Hollow CAN be in the North wing. C is not must-be-true. D: Ivory in South (positions 5–6). Can Ivory be in Center (positions 3–4)? Finch=1, then Ivory at 3 or 4. E.g., Finch=1,Knoll=2,Ivory=3,Garnet=4,Jasper=5,Hollow=6: Garnet(4)<Jasper(5) good; Hollow(6) Knoll(2) not adjacent |6−2|=4 good; Garnet not at 3 so conditional doesn't fire. Valid — Ivory in Center. So D is not must-be-true. E: Jasper in South (5–6). Can Jasper be in Center? Jasper at 3 requires Garnet at 1 or 2, but pos 1 is Finch, so Garnet at 2. Garnet=2,Jasper=3: Conditional doesn't fire (Garnet not at 3). Remaining: Hollow, Ivory, Knoll at 4,5,6 with Ivory not at 1–2 (fine) and Hollow/Knoll not adjacent. Try Ivory=4,Knoll=5,Hollow=6: |5−6|=1 adjacent violation. Ivory=4,Hollow=5,Knoll=6:|5−6|=1 adjacent violation. Ivory=5,Knoll=4,Hollow=6:|4−6|=2 not adjacent — valid. So Jasper can be in Center. E not must-be-true. A: Knoll in North (position 2). Can Knoll NOT be in North? Many verified solutions have Knoll at positions 3–6. So A not must-be-true. Returning to B: Garnet in Center or South. We showed Garnet CAN be at position 2 (North). So B is also not must-be-true as stated... This requires re-examining. Among the verified solutions provided, all have Garnet at 3–6. However I showed a valid case with Garnet at 2 above: Finch=1,Garnet=2,Jasper=3,Ivory=5,Knoll=4,Hollow=6 — let me verify all rules: (1) Finch at 1 ✓; (2/3) Ivory not at 1–2 ✓ (at 5); (4) Garnet(2)<Jasper(3) ✓; (5) Hollow(6) Knoll(4) |6−4|=2 not adjacent ✓; (6) Garnet not at 3, conditional doesn't fire ✓. This IS valid. So B is not necessarily true. The must-be-true question needs a reliable answer. Let me reason about what truly must be true given Finch=1 and Ivory∉{1,2}: Ivory is always in positions 3–6. The only entity that MUST be excluded from certain positions is Ivory from North. A reliable must-be-true: 'Ivory is displayed in either the Center or the South wing.' Let me re-map choices to make D correct: D says 'Ivory is displayed in the South wing' — that's too strong. What about 'Ivory is not displayed in the North wing'? That follows directly from rules 2+3 and is always true. Let me restate the question with revised choices where C is the correct answer.
explanations.A: Knoll can appear at positions 3, 4, 5, or 6 in valid arrangements, so Knoll need not be in the North wing.
explanations.B: Garnet may occupy position 2 (North-2) in a valid arrangement — for instance with Finch at 1, Garnet at 2, Jasper at 3, Knoll at 4, Ivory at 5, Hollow at 6 — so Garnet is not restricted to the Center or South wings.
explanations.C: Correct. Rules 2 and 3 together bar Ivory from both North-wing slots (positions 1 and 2), so Ivory must always appear in the Center or South wing.
explanations.D: Ivory can occupy a Center-wing slot (position 3 or 4) in valid arrangements, so Ivory need not be in the South wing.
explanations.E: Jasper can appear in the Center wing (e.g., position 3 or 4) in valid arrangements, so Jasper need not be in the South wing.

explanations.B: With Garnet in the Center wing, Jasper must be in the South wing. Ivory cannot be at positions 1–2. If Hollow is at position 2, all remaining positions (3–6) hold Garnet, Jasper, Ivory, and Knoll. Hollow(2) and Knoll cannot be adjacent, so Knoll cannot be at position 3. However, this by itself does not make this impossible — but checking every sub-case, whenever Garnet is at 3 the conditional forces Ivory to 6, and with Garnet at 4 and Hollow at 2, Hollow(2) and Knoll are not adjacent only if Knoll is at 4+, but Garnet occupies 4, leaving Knoll at 5 or 6 alongside Jasper and Ivory — a valid arrangement exists. Hollow at position 2 IS possible, so this is not the right impossible choice.

explanations.D: Knoll at position 4 requires Garnet at position 3 (since Garnet must be in Center, i.e., 3 or 4, and position 4 is taken by Knoll). Garnet at 3 fires the conditional, placing Ivory at 6. Remaining positions 2 and 5 hold Hollow and Jasper (Jasper must be after Garnet, so Jasper at 5 or 6; Jasper=5). So: Finch=1,?=2,Garnet=3,Knoll=4,Jasper=5,Ivory=6 with Hollow at 2. Hollow(2) Knoll(4): |4−2|=2 not adjacent ✓. Valid. So D could be true — not impossible.

questions.questionStem: If Jasper is displayed at position 3, which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A

choices.label: B
choices.text: Hollow is displayed in the South wing.

choices.label: C

choices.label: E

explanations.correct: With Jasper at position 3 (Center-1), Garnet must be at a position lower than 3. Position 1 is occupied by Finch, so Garnet must be at position 2 — the only remaining position below 3. This must be true in every valid arrangement under this condition.
explanations.A: Correct. Garnet must precede Jasper (rule 4). Jasper is at position 3. The only positions lower than 3 are 1 (occupied by Finch) and 2. Therefore Garnet must be at position 2.
explanations.B: With Garnet=2 and Jasper=3, the remaining entities — Hollow, Ivory, Knoll — fill positions 4, 5, 6 (Ivory not at 1–2, already satisfied). Hollow could be at position 4 (Center-2) rather than the South wing, so Hollow need not be in the South wing.
explanations.C: The conditional fires only when Garnet is at position 3. Here Garnet is at position 2, so the conditional does not apply and Ivory is not forced to position 6. Ivory can be at 4, 5, or 6.
explanations.D: Knoll fills one of positions 4, 5, 6 in this scenario (Finch=1, Garnet=2, Jasper=3, with Hollow/Ivory/Knoll at 4/5/6). Knoll is therefore in the Center or South wing, not the North wing.
explanations.E: Position 1 is fixed as Finch per rule 1. Garnet cannot be at position 1.
